rv: This is an excellent film. I have no idea why it is classified as "Science Fiction/Horror". It is a DOCUMENTARY. It is also a feminist film, displaying (for its time) a profound understanding of the tangles belief in (an evil form of) witchcraft produces; and giving new insight into the formula "damned if you do and damned if you don't".
